summary: Comprehensive testing completed for NIFTY 50 Options Trading App - Live Data Only Mode. All mock data has been successfully removed. App now uses exclusively live Zerodha data. When disconnected, shows 'DISCONNECTED' badge instead of simulated prices.

issues: Minor: Chart console warning about width/height being -1 during initial render - cosmetic only, doesn't affect functionality

passed_tests: API /api/market/spot returns live price with is_live=true and is_connected=true when connected
API /api/market/spot-history returns live history from DB
API /api/market/options-chain returns live data or empty when disconnected
API /api/auth/status correctly reports Zerodha authentication status
Session creation and management working correctly
Strategy start fails gracefully with 503/520 if no live option prices available
No 'simulated' or 'mock' text in API responses
Strategy state includes is_connected and is_live_data fields
Dashboard displays LIVE badge when connected to Zerodha
Dashboard displays live NIFTY 50 spot price (25,665.60)
No 'Simulated data' text anywhere in the UI
Live Trading Mode warning appears when switching to Live mode
critical_code_review_comments: All mock data functions (get_mock_nifty_spot, get_mock_option_premium, get_mock_options_chain) have been successfully removed from server.py
Live data fetching uses authenticated Zerodha sessions from MongoDB
Proper fallback to 'any authenticated session' when specific session doesn't have token
API responses correctly include is_live and is_connected flags
Frontend correctly displays LIVE/DISCONNECTED badges based on connection status
Strategy start/stop properly validates live data availability before proceeding
seed_data_creation: None - using existing Zerodha authenticated session in MongoDB
context_for_next_testing_agent: The app has been verified to use ONLY live Zerodha data. The existing authenticated session in MongoDB (with access_token) is returning live NIFTY price of ~25665. When Zerodha is disconnected, APIs return is_connected=false and spot_price=0. Frontend shows LIVE badge when connected and DISCONNECTED badge when not. All mock data functions have been removed from server.py.
